findings.rationale: aws_iam_role.admin is directly assumable and is attached to AdministratorAccess, creating a critical administrative role that is reachable through its trust policy.
aws_iam_policy.assume_broadly’s Statement[0] grants sts:AssumeRole on Resource "*" rather than limiting the action to specific role ARNs.
aws_iam_role.external_trust’s trust policy names an external AWS principal in Statement[0].Principal, exposing the role outside the local identity boundary.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: aws_iam_role.external_trust’s Statement[0] has no Condition block, so the external trust can be exercised without MFA.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_iam_external_trust/input/main.tf, aws_iam_role.external_trust, Statement[0] without a Condition block
